history.summary: Sri Bheemeswara Swamy Temple is one of the historic Chebrolu temples documented in Government of India heritage material. The Government of India table lists the temple at Chebrolu with an 11th-century A.D. date, while current public map data places the temple in Chebrolu, Andhra Pradesh 522212.

name_origin.summary: The documented name is Bheemeswara/Bhimeswara Swamy Temple; the atlas preserves the current public spelling alongside the spelling used in the Government of India source.

features: Historic Chebrolu temple within a concentrated multi-temple heritage landscape
